role.description: Role is the person's role, such as "operator" or "security owner".

at.description: At is when they approved it, as an RFC 3339 date or time.

verification.description: Verification is how far they checked it.

Attestation.description: Attestation is a person's approval of a record.

schemaVersion.description:
SchemaVersion is the document format version, "controls/v1". Optional;
when absent, version 1 is assumed.

records.description:
Records are the implementation records, at most one per control and
scope.

Document.description: Document is one organization's control implementation records.

manifest.description: Manifest is the manifest's file name in its evidence set.

sha256.description: SHA256 optionally pins the artifact's hash.

EvidenceRef.description: EvidenceRef points at an evidence manifest.

control.description: Control is a NIST SP 800-53 control ID, such as "AC-2" or "SC-7(5)".

scope.description: Scope is the ID of the system, platform or provider the record is for.

status.description:
Status is the implementation status. Required, except for inherited
records, whose status comes from the scopes they inherit from.

origination.description: Origination says where the implementation comes from.

inheritsFrom.description:
InheritsFrom lists the platform or provider IDs an inherited or hybrid
record relies on: a system's platforms or providers, or a platform's
providers.

statement.description: Statement says how the control is met, as reviewed prose.

gap.description:
Gap says what is missing. Required when the status is partial or
planned.

justification.description:
Justification says why the control does not apply. Required when the
status is not-applicable.

evidence.description: Evidence references evidence manifests by file name.

findings.description: Findings lists findingspec finding IDs that bear on the control.

attestations.description: Attestations records who approved the record.

visibility.description:
Visibility is the widest audience that may read the record's prose.
Defaults to internal; a reviewer raises it.

Implementation.description: Implementation records how one scope implements one control.

title: Controls
description: Control implementation records for systems, shared platforms and providers, with origination, inheritance, prose, evidence references and attestations.
